ROOT_CAUSE_EVENT_LOOP: Multiple asyncio.run() invocations in the runner (one per case) reused the same httpx.AsyncHTTPTransport across loops. The transport bound its internal connection pool and timers to the first event loop, which was closed when P03 finished. Starting P05 in a new asyncio.run() triggered RuntimeError: Event loop is closed on the transport.
ROOT_CAUSE_P03_RECORD_LOSS: Deferred batch persistence architecture in the runner: case results were held in memory and only written to disk at process exit via generate_all_reproduction_artifacts. Additionally, an unhandled exception (catching non-existent gemini.ProviderError causing AttributeError) during the P03->P05 transition crashed the process before batch persistence was reached.

AUDIT_FINDINGS.event_loop_lifecycle: Unified lifetime matching the batch coordinator
AUDIT_FINDINGS.transport_client_lifecycle: Created within the unified event loop, used for all cases, explicitly closed via aclose() in finally block
AUDIT_FINDINGS.p03_to_p05_sequence: P03 transport -> trace capture -> scoring -> atomic disk write -> read-back verification -> P05 reservation
AUDIT_FINDINGS.reserve_request_slot_location: Inside execute_case_with_state_machine immediately before transport dispatch
AUDIT_FINDINGS.transport_completion_record_location: Immediately after transport returns HTTP status or raises
AUDIT_FINDINGS.safe_trace_capture_location: In-memory extraction before scoring; raw output never persisted
AUDIT_FINDINGS.scoring_location: Evaluated strictly from safe trace; exceptions recorded as MEASUREMENT_ERROR without losing transport observation
AUDIT_FINDINGS.atomic_write_location: Executed per case via CaseJournal: tempfile -> flush -> fsync -> os.replace
AUDIT_FINDINGS.read_back_verification_location: Immediately following atomic replace; validates JSON format and case completion
AUDIT_FINDINGS.p03_trace_loss_mechanism: Process crashed before batch persistence was executed
AUDIT_FINDINGS.exception_occurrence_point: During P05 setup / transport initialization, before P05 was reserved or sent
